content: आग्नेय {%a.%} (-यी|{%f.%}) [अग्नेरिदम् अग्निर्देवता वास्य ढक्] .²1 Belonging to Agni; fiery. <ls>Vāj. 24. 6</ls>. .²2 Offered or consecrated to Agni; अभिशस्तो मृषा कृच्छ्रं चरेदाग्नेयमेव वा <ls>Y. 3. 287</ls>. .²3 Similar to fire (as an insect). .²4 Increasing the fire in the stomach; stimulating digestion. .²5 Kindling the fire (as ghee <ab>&c.</ab>) शणसर्जरसादीनि यानि द्रव्याणि कानिचित् . आग्नेयान्युत सन्तीह <ls>Mb. 1. 144. 9</ls>. .²6 Belonging to Āgnāyī. .{@-यः@} .²1 An epithet of Skanda or Kārtikeya. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Agastya. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a country. .²4 A worshipper of Agni. .²5 An offering or oblation to Svāhā. .{@-यी@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the wife of Agni. .²2 The south-east quarter (presided over by Agni). .²3 The first day of a month (प्रतिपत्तिथि which is presided over by Agni). .²4 A kind of योगधारणा; <ls>Bhāg. 11. 31. 6</ls>. .{@-यम्@} .²1 The lunar mansion called Kṛttikā. <ls>Mb. 13. 104. 127</ls>. .²2 Gold. .²3 Blood. .²4 Lac, the red animal dye. .²5 Ghee. .²6 A missile presided over by Agni. .²7 A {%Mantra%} used in the worship of Agni. .²8 A descendant of Agni. .²9 Bathing by applying sacred ashes to the body (भस्ममर्दनपूर्वकस्नानम्). .²10 A kind of worm.
